item.title: Apple Opens Siri AI to Developers with App Skills
item.description: Apple’s new Siri AI ‘app skills’ let any iOS or macOS app create multi‑step voice actions, debuting in iOS 27.3 and macOS 27.3 for developers today.

item.title: Apple Opens Siri AI to All Apps in iOS 27.3 Preview
item.description: Apple’s iOS 27.3 Developer Preview lets Siri AI act across any third‑party app, using personal context, natural language and on‑screen awareness.

item.title: watchOS 27 Adds Siri Modular Face to Apple Watch

item.title: Why Apple Won’t Let Siri Be Your Virtual Therapist
item.description: Survey finds Americans treat AI chatbots as friends or therapists, prompting Apple to program Siri AI to block pseudo‑relationships and protect wellbeing.

item.title: Siri AI Waitlist Delays iOS 27 & macOS 27 Access
item.description: Apple’s new Siri AI waitlist means iOS 27 and macOS 27 users must join a beta queue, delaying access to the latest voice assistant features.

item.title: Apple’s Siri AI Upgrade May Introduce iCloud+ Paywall
item.description: Apple hints at a paywall for Siri AI users, using iCloud+ subscriptions while licensing Google’s Gemini model amid AI‑driven hardware cost hikes.

item.title: Apple’s $250 Million Siri Settlement Approved
item.description: Apple’s $250 million Siri privacy settlement has been approved, detailing the payout structure and its ripple effects across tech, law, and AI.
